coverage: The training corpus covers **in-scope Common Core State Standards for Mathematics from Kindergarten through Grade 6 (K–6)**, using dataset v0.31.0-01 and ontology v0.31.0. The [Coverage Explorer](https://coverage.edugraph.io) documents competency coverage and scope exclusions. This describes curriculum scope, not verified model mastery of every standard. The selected adapter was trained on 2,330 images.
limitations: Both GGUF repeats produced identical outputs and 43/64 exact matches, versus 47/64 for the selected NF4 source: four fewer exact cases (6.25 percentage points). No matching standalone BF16 diagnostic was run. These are regression measurements: 147 of 403 training labels are absent from official validation, and 224 official validation images reuse bytes from a previously inspected assessment. That overlap covers selection and final validation together, not only this 64-image benchmark. Realized-range annotations, label completeness and a fresh assessment remain follow-up work. This GGUF was tested on the checkpoint-selection cohort; its performance on the separate 414-image final cohort is unmeasured. Runtime measurements apply to the tested hardware and do not establish fit or latency on other devices. Classroom performance and unfamiliar task types remain unmeasured.
